crossRefs.note: The proud and arrogant man—“Scoffer” is his name— he works in the arrogance of pride.
For lack of wood a fire goes out. Without gossip, a quarrel dies down.
As coals are to hot embers, and wood to fire, so is a contentious man to kindling strife.

translations.web: Drive out the mocker, and strife will go out; yes, quarrels and insults will stop.
translations.bsb: Drive out the mocker, and conflict will depart; even quarreling and insults will cease.
translations.kjv: Cast out the scorner, and contention shall go out; yea, strife and reproach shall cease.
translations.asv: Cast out the scoffer, and contention will go out; Yea, strife and ignominy will cease.
